notes: Today src/cli.mjs only prints the usage line and exits 2, and src/store.mjs does not exist. T3 creates src/store.mjs and gives src/cli.mjs its shape: the command switch, the usage error (exit 2) for anything but `add` and `list`, and one try/catch around the commands that prints a thrown error's message to stderr and exits 1. T1 adds its branch to that shape. No dependency is added; package.json stays without one.

Names and errors: `add` takes the arguments after `add` joined by one space (`add buy milk` and `add "buy milk"` both save `buy milk`), then trims surrounding whitespace. Under spec A2 the trimmed name is blank when nothing remains or when a line break remains inside it; saveItem then throws new Error("item name must not be blank") before writing. A missing argument is the empty string, so it is blank. The try/catch from T3 prints the message to stderr and exits 1.

Checks: item-add (AC1), item-blank (AC2: spaces only, no argument, a line break inside the name) and item-list (AC3) each start by removing data/items.jsonl and run every command as its own process, so each case starts from nothing and list reads from disk in a new process.
